subject: Extract one conditional-economic-offer algebra across food housing services and provider economics

body.text: The current company-wide stress test exposes a strong cross-domain isomorphism that should become a mature shared primitive, not three domain hacks. Grocery coupons/BOGO/rebates/points, housing concessions/free weeks/gift cards/locator rebates, service bundles/discounts, and provider credits/discount schedules all describe conditional economic offers. Derive the smallest canonical economics algebra already compatible with existing owners: offer identity; applies-to object/scope; eligibility predicates; effective interval; location/channel/term; benefit kind and amount/unit; minimum/threshold; stack/compatibility relation; redemption/settlement state; evidence/source/confidence; observed_at vs effective_at; and explicit unknown/conflict. Domain layers keep their specialized semantics and map into this algebra. Crucial laws: advertised offer != realized FinancialEvent; projected effective price != billed/settled amount; points/free-period/rebate are different benefit kinds; incompatible offers cannot be silently summed; source disagreement is TraceDivergence; expired offers stop applying without rewriting historical observations. Exercise it on at least one current food deal, one housing concession, and one service/provider-side economic term if real evidence exists. Then make semantic shell COMPARE/WHY/RECONCILE able to traverse the shared structure.
